note: Every third-party input the Fedora desktop delivery bakes into the RPM, pinned to an immutable identity and checked by SHA-256 before use. ops/fetch_pinned.py is the only thing that downloads any of it; a local cache may hold the bytes but never decides what they are.

build.why: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for the whole packaging run: file mtimes in the payload, the RPM BUILDTIME header, and anything else that would otherwise read a wall clock. Declared here rather than derived from the commit date so that adding acceptance evidence to the delivery commit — which is not an input to the artifact — cannot change the artifact's bytes. Bump it deliberately when the delivery is re-cut.

python.why: The same python-build-standalone release uv resolves for `cpython-3.12.13-linux-x86_64-gnu`, so the interpreter in the package is byte-for-byte the build the test suite runs on. ops/build-runtime.sh asserts that parity against backend/.venv and refuses to package if it ever drifts.

uv.why: The resolver that turns backend/uv.lock into the shipped site-packages. Pinned and verified so the package does not depend on whichever uv happens to be on the builder's PATH.

embedder.why: An exact commit on the model repository, not a mutable branch, and an explicit file list — the package must not depend on which revision happens to be in a Hugging Face cache on the build machine, nor pick up files that were never declared.
